note: Literature confirms MSL2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (Karayol-Borroto-Haghshenas syndrome) consistently presents with core global developmental delay and intellectual disability across cohorts.

evidence.text: Karayol et al. identified a cohort of 25 individuals with heterozygous de novo MSL2 variants presenting with neurodevelopmental disorder phenotypes including global developmental delay and intellectual disability.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: MSL2 variants were associated with NDD phenotypes including global developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia, and motor issues such as coordination problems, feeding difficulties, and gait disturbance.

evidence.text: Lu et al. evaluated clinical features associated with novel MSL2 protein-truncating variants, noting developmental delay and intellectual disability among the core phenotypes.

source.title: Novel protein-truncating variants of a chromatin-modifying gene MSL2 in syndromic neurodevelopmental disorders
